description: Set the anisotropy search parameters (radius, tolerance). Not in the 9.8 manual; `mpoint anisotropy ?` on MPoint3D 9.8.54 lists the keywords radius and tolerance and prints a marker line '*** Mpoint-Anisotropy-1 ***'. What the parameters control is not documented.
notes: Live-discovered on MPoint3D 9.7 (2026-09-14): 'mpoint ?' enumerates it, but it has no page in the MPM doc tree and no entry in the installed command index (out_commands.txt).

Semantics are NOT established. On 9.7 the command took no arguments; on MPoint3D 9.8.54 `mpoint anisotropy ?` lists radius (float >= 0) and tolerance (float in [0, 1]), still with no page in the MPM doc tree. It is documented here only so that a command met in someone else's script can be looked up -- do not infer behaviour from the name.
The marker-style output suggests an internal or diagnostic command rather than a modelling one. (state: ran it on a 512-point model; no change observed in point count, positions or node count.)

keywords.name: radius
keywords.description: A floating point value >= 0 (the engine's own token description).

keywords.name: tolerance
keywords.description: A floating point value between 0 and 1 (the engine's own token description).
